note: The library's fixed words. An entry that uses a word not listed here is refused; add a word here deliberately (python -m tools.catalog vocab add ...), never ad hoc, so that one thing has one name.

tile_class.material: a repeating surface with no subject: brick, plank, plaster, rock, metal, earth, water
tile_class.architecture: a picture of a building part meant to be laid once or in a row: facade with windows, door leaf, column, arch, cornice, panelling
tile_class.fixture: a thing fixed to a wall or ceiling: lamp, switch, pipe run, vent, grate, sign plate, clock, shelf front
tile_class.furniture: a thing that stands on a floor and is used: chair, table, bed, counter, stool, bench, cabinet
tile_class.object: a loose thing: bottle, crate, barrel, tool, book, body part, pickup-like prop
tile_class.machine: machinery or a vehicle part: console, engine, gear, train side, pump
tile_class.decal: a mark laid over a surface: blood, stain, crack, cobweb, graffiti, poster, painting, plaque
tile_class.glass: a window pane or stained glass, see-through or not
tile_class.mask: a see-through pattern for a masked wall or floor: bars, lattice, fence, railing, net
tile_class.plant: vegetation: tree, bush, vine, grass, flowers
tile_class.creature: an actor, corpse or statue of a figure
tile_class.sign: lettering or a board with words or a symbol on it
tile_class.effect: fire, smoke, light glow, sparks, water splash
tile_class.engine: an editor or engine marker never meant to be seen

tile_layout.band: repeats along one axis only (a frieze, a rail, a skirting)
tile_layout.picture: one subject; must be shown whole, never cut or repeated
tile_layout.sprite: a cut-out thing with see-through surround

scale.map: a whole level: what it is about (id: the map name)
scale.venue: a building or district of several rooms (id: MAP:sector of its main room)
scale.place: one room or yard (id: MAP:sector, as the place catalogue lists it)
scale.thing: one piece of furniture or one object built of sectors or sprites (id: MAP:sector of the thing)

confidence.seen: somebody looked at a frame of it
confidence.inferred: read from fields, lettering or a study, not looked at
confidence.guessed: the catalogue's own hypothesis from tile themes; to be checked by looking

mechanism_kind.door-switch: a switch or lever opens or shuts a door
mechanism_kind.key-door: a door that wants a key
mechanism_kind.lift: a floor that carries the player between levels
mechanism_kind.crusher: a ceiling or floor that closes to hurt
mechanism_kind.blast-hole: an explosion (object, crack, barrel) opens a wall
mechanism_kind.secret: a hidden door or wall opened by pushing, shooting or a hidden switch
mechanism_kind.ambush: entering or picking something up releases or spawns enemies
mechanism_kind.light-switch: a switch or event changes lighting
mechanism_kind.kill-counter: something happens once enough enemies are dead
mechanism_kind.combination: several switches must be set to a pattern
mechanism_kind.sequence: a chain of timed steps set off by one trigger
mechanism_kind.conveyor: a floor that pans and drags
mechanism_kind.moving-scenery: a train, a carousel, a gear, a bobbing thing with no gameplay role
mechanism_kind.trap: something that hurts when triggered: flame, blade, explosion, pit
mechanism_kind.level-start: set going by the start of the level
